messages:
Kyle: heads up — eu-west tranche hit sustained GPU headroom around 17:05, queue depth +120%, a handful of 503s seen. Investigating.
Meera: on it. is it a single-tenant burst or multi-tenant?
Samir: looks like one customer sent long-context bursts + many short chat completions. KV cache warmup poor — miss rate ~30% higher than baseline.
Lia: also saw egress queue backs up on two hosts, NIC counters spiking. possible network congestion > spotty backpressure.
Samir: timeline from logs:
```
17:03 node-42 kv-miss-rate 48%
17:04 p99-latency 1.2s -> 2.6s
17:05 egress-queue-depth host-7 300 -> drop 503
```
Meera: TLDR: compute busy + cache cold + occasional NIC congestion = admission needed.
ops-oncall: I flipped soft-shed policy at 17:10 (admission=priority-shed canary) — dropped failed requests from ~6% -> 0.9% within 2m.
Kyle: can we summarize what soft-shed did? what got declined vs queued?
ops-oncall: soft-shed does watermark-based admit. premium tokens bypass until high-water; standard gets capped; best-effort queued and then rejected when queue length > 500.
Lia: also enabled cross-region route for premium traffic to us-west as a last resort. small spike in cross-region egress but latency stayed ~42ms.
Meera: cost note: cross-region routing at scale will add egress + remote gpu price; worth only for premium SLA. consider model-fallback for standard tier.
Kyle: propose: formalize two levers — (1) tiered admission + soft-shed, (2) model-fallback chain for standard/best-effort before cross-region.
Samir: example fallback chain we tested: fp16-quant-8bit -> small-llm-1.3b. quality drop measured with eval prompts: 3.7% BLEU-ish metric regression, acceptable for standard.
Meera: config sketch I pushed to the runbook:
```
admission:
  mode: priority-shed
  watermark_high: 85%
  watermark_low: 60%
  tiers:
    - name: premium
      min_share: 0.5
    - name: standard
      min_share: 0.3
    - name: best-effort
      min_share: 0.2
fallback:
  sequence: [fp16-quant-8bit, small-llm-1.3b]
routing:
  prefer_local: true
  cross_region_budget_tokens_per_min: 1200
```
Lia: note: add a fast path cache-warmup flag so the cache prefetcher prioritizes sessions migrating to fallback models. otherwise we lose perf.
ops-oncall: action items: roll out priority-shed as default canary to 10% clusters by EOD; enable model-fallback for "standard" tenants in canary; add metric: cross-region-cost-per-minute.
Kyle: decision: for now adopt latency-first for premium (prefer local, only cross-region if remote-latency < 50ms and cost multiplier < 2x). standard->model-fallback then cross-region as a last resort.
Meera: I'll update the incident playbook and add flowchart + rollback steps. Samir, Lia, can you add automation for watermark thresholds and cache-warmup hint?
Samir: yep, will open PR with a small admissions controller change + tests.
Lia: I'll add NIC queue alerts and a short runbook entry for toggling egress shaping on affected hosts.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary policy "priority-shed-v1" promoted to 10% clusters by ops-oncall at 17:12. :white_check_mark:
Kyle: good work. follow-up tomorrow: simulate tenant burst scenarios with new fallback chain and quantify cost delta for cross-region as a comparison.
Meera: noted — will schedule test and share results in #eng-infra. :thumbsup:
